name: DẤU MỐC — Video Design System
style: Historical Editorial × Archive Newspaper × Contemporary Documentary
colorRules: Use paper (#FAF8F3) for most graphic scenes; pure white when cleaner contrast is appropriate.
Use burgundy (#873F43) to identify the key event, date, person, or turning point.
Use antique gold (#B18B55) sparingly; avoid metallic or shiny effects.
Preserve original colors and tonal range of archival materials; avoid artificial sepia washes over real photos.
